meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给应用增加聊天消息渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Telegram chat to your existing app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add a chat channel to your app.

howto.what: Claude 会从 channels 分支复制 Telegram 适配器、配对与 markdown 清理助手及测试，注册到频道入口，安装 chat-adapter 包，再构建并跑注册测试；随后引导你创建 bot、粘贴 token、重启服务，并用 4 位配对码绑定聊天。
howto.when: 当你为 NanoClaw 添加 Telegram 频道，或在 `/setup`、`/manage-channels` 流程中接线频道时接管。

say.text: 帮我给 NanoClaw 加上 Telegram 频道支持
say.note: 会复制适配器、装依赖并跑注册测试

say.text: 开始 Telegram 配对，把这个聊天接到 agent 上
say.note: 会打印 4 位码，让你发给机器人

say.text: 我的 Telegram 机器人在群里收不到消息

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Telegram adapter, its helpers and tests from the channels branch, registers it, installs @chat-adapter/telegram@4.29.0, builds and runs the registration test, then guides bot setup, token, restart and 4-digit pairing.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you add Telegram channel support to NanoClaw, or when wiring a channel during /setup or /manage-channels.

say_en.text: Add Telegram channel support to NanoClaw
say_en.note: Copies the adapter, installs the package, runs the registration test

say_en.text: Start Telegram pairing for this chat
say_en.note: Prints a 4-digit code for you to send to the bot

say_en.text: My Telegram bot can't see messages in group chats
say_en.note: Points to turning off Group Privacy in BotFather
